summary: Build an exhaustive, deduplicated scenario catalog for validating active pricing procedure V21

scenarios.name: Catalog/list-priced new line (PricingSource not LastTransaction)
scenarios.what_it_tests: A standard non-contracted, non-derived line is priced directly from the catalog price book entry (Product2.ListPrice via PBE) with no adjustment, rather than from a prior transaction
scenarios.proc_mechanism: DP2 List Price step (Line.ListPrice = PricebookEntry.UnitPrice); Price Book Entries; Attribute Pricing Filter (ItemPricingSource NotEquals 'LastTransaction'); Quantity*Price (ItemPricingSource NotEquals 'LastTransaction')
scenarios.expected_behavior: NetUnitPrice/UnitPrice resolves from PBE list price; Quantity*Price computes ItemNetTotalPrice = NetUnitPrice * Qty; discounts applied downstream
scenarios.test_setup: New quote, Cyber brand Software (e.g. Digital Guardian/Cobalt Strike), One-Time/Perpetual, Qty=5, USD, Direct, no attributes, IsContracted=null

scenarios.name: LastTransaction-sourced line bypasses catalog repricing (carry-forward)
scenarios.what_it_tests: A line whose ItemPricingSource='LastTransaction' must SKIP catalog price book, attribute pricing, partner/volume discount, and Quantity*Price recompute, preserving the prior-transaction price; on order reprice the prior order price is also preserved
scenarios.proc_mechanism: Negative filters (ItemPricingSource NotEquals 'LastTransaction') on Attribute Pricing Filter, Quantity*Price, Manual Quote Level Discount, Partner Discount Derived Maint, List Operation; ListOperation80 (Equals 'LastTransaction') handles carry-forward
scenarios.expected_behavior: Prior-transaction/order NetUnitPrice preserved; no catalog re-derivation
scenarios.test_setup: Renewal/amend or order-reprice line with ItemPricingSource='LastTransaction', Qty=2

scenarios.name: Derived asset price on renewal (inherit Asset.Price, not catalog)
scenarios.what_it_tests: A renewal quote line inherits its UnitPrice from the prior Asset.Price (the net price that was invoiced) via native pull, not a fresh pricebook lookup
scenarios.proc_mechanism: Derived Products - Native Pull; Derived Pricing Filter (ItemIsDerived=true); QuoteAction(Renew) -> Asset.Price -> QuoteLineItem.UnitPrice (pre-COLA)
scenarios.expected_behavior: Renewal line UnitPrice equals the prior invoiced Asset price, not the current pricebook entry
scenarios.test_setup: Renewal quote, QuoteAction.Type='Renew', line refs prior-order Asset, same product

scenarios.name: Contracted/asset-sourced line stamps PricingDate
scenarios.what_it_tests: A line tied to an existing contract/asset stamps PricingDate=EffectiveDate so contracted pricing is honored on its effective date rather than a fresh catalog lookup
scenarios.proc_mechanism: Contacted Pricing (IsContracted IsNotNull AND IsContracted=true AND PricingDate IsNull -> set PricingDate=EffectiveDate)
scenarios.expected_behavior: PricingDate set from EffectiveDate; contracted price effective-date alignment applied
scenarios.test_setup: Software contracted asset line, IsContracted=true, PricingDate=null, Txn=Amend on existing contract

scenarios.name: Derived non-derived exclusion from derived filters
scenarios.what_it_tests: A standard line (ItemIsDerived=false/null) must NOT enter Derived Pricing Filter, Derived Maintenance Net Filter, or Stamp Contributor Base derived branches; standard waterfall applies
scenarios.proc_mechanism: Derived Pricing Filter / Derived Maintenance Net Filter (ItemIsDerived Equals true) exclude it; Stamp Base Filter ((ItemIsDerived IsNull OR =false)) includes it
scenarios.expected_behavior: Standard waterfall applies; derived formula skipped
scenarios.test_setup: Software line, ItemIsDerived=false, Qty=3, New quote

scenarios.name: Contracted-vs-catalog source switch mid-quote (IsContracted toggled / asset detach)
scenarios.what_it_tests: When a line's IsContracted/ItemPricingSource changes between reprices (e.g. asset detached so a contracted line reverts to catalog, or a fresh line becomes contracted), the procedure must re-route between Contacted Pricing and the catalog waterfall and clear the stale PricingDate; verifies the source-switch transition, not just steady-state A-02/A-04
scenarios.proc_mechanism: Contacted Pricing (IsContracted=true AND PricingDate IsNull) vs catalog DP2 List Price; on switch to catalog the negative IsContracted branch + PricingDate must reset so a stale contracted PricingDate doesn't pin an old pricebook date
scenarios.expected_behavior: Toggling IsContracted re-routes the line: contracted->catalog clears PricingDate and re-derives from PBE as-of EffectiveDate; catalog->contracted seeds PricingDate; no stale-date carryover
scenarios.test_setup: Line first priced contracted (PricingDate seeded), detach asset / set IsContracted=false, reprice -> expect catalog price + reset PricingDate

scenarios.name: Derived maintenance family inconsistency (BoKS vs FIM)
scenarios.what_it_tests: BoKS new-maintenance derives correctly (20% tier x 355 list = 71) but FIM new-maintenance either 100%-copies list or prices $0 because FIM products carry no Maintenance Type Defn attribute, falling to native Formula=UnitPrice or unbound
scenarios.proc_mechanism: DerivedPricingFormula tier lookup on Maintenance_Rate__mdt / Maintenance Type Defn attribute; missing attribute -> native Formula=UnitPrice fallback (100% copy) or unbound $0
scenarios.expected_behavior: All maintenance products should carry Maintenance Type Defn; if missing, fallback should be a documented standard (e.g. Standard 20%), not variable 100% or $0
scenarios.test_setup: New quote (a) BoKS license+maint expect 355x20%=71; (b) FIM license+maint expect FIM-standard-rate x list

scenarios.name: One-Time/Perpetual selling model PricingTermCount=1
scenarios.what_it_tests: A perpetual/one-time line gets PricingTermCount stamped to the one-time constant so Subscription Pricing computes a single-term price; order creates Activated non-subscription Asset and recognizes full revenue
scenarios.proc_mechanism: Assignment (OneTimePricingTermCountConstant -> PricingTermCount); Subscription Pricing (PricingTermCountValueOneConstant); ProductSellingModel='One-Time'
scenarios.expected_behavior: PricingTermCount=1; ItemNetTotalPrice = NetUnitPrice * Qty * 1; Asset.IsSubscription=false, full revenue recognized
scenarios.test_setup: Perpetual software (e.g. Cobalt Strike), One-Time/Perpetual, Qty=1-4, USD, Direct, no support

scenarios.name: Term-Defined subscription (annual, renewable) with proration enabled
scenarios.what_it_tests: A Term-Defined line with StartProrationPeriod and ItemSubscriptionTerm enters the term-defined proration path, stamps PricingTermCount, and creates an Asset lifecycle (SubscriptionEndDate, renewal automation >=90 days before expiry)
scenarios.proc_mechanism: Term-Defined proration filter (SellingModelType='TermDefined' AND StartProrationPeriod IsNotNull AND ItemSubscriptionTerm IsNotNull); ProrationTermDefined element -> PricingTermCount; ListOperationTermDefinedPTC
scenarios.expected_behavior: Term proration computed; PricingTermCount derived (1 annual or fractional); Asset.IsSubscription=true with SubscriptionEndDate=Start+term; renewal auto-created >=90 days prior
scenarios.test_setup: Subscription software (e.g. Digital Guardian DLP yearly), Term-Defined, ItemSubscriptionTerm=12/36, StartProrationPeriod set, Qty=10

scenarios.name: Usage / tiered-quantity model (PhishLabs, Tripwire, Alert Logic)
scenarios.what_it_tests: Subscription line whose price is computed by a customer attribute (assets, revenue, users, nodes) via CalculationMatrix tier lookup, multiplying NetUnitPrice by full PricingTermCount across the subscription duration
scenarios.proc_mechanism: Subscription Pricing (LineItemQuantity * PricingTermCount * InputUnitPrice -> InputUnitPrice); Subscription Aggregate Price; CalculationMatrix rows keyed on attribute-value range (Base + Attr*Multiplier or direct tier)
scenarios.expected_behavior: Line total = Base + (attribute x multiplier) or tier price, applied per term; ItemNetTotalPrice reflects qty * term-count * unit price
scenarios.test_setup: PhishLabs Domain Protection, customer revenue 25B, tiered table multiplier; or Subscription Term-Defined term=12 Qty=8

scenarios.name: Evergreen subscription (SaaS, no defined term end) full-period count
scenarios.what_it_tests: An Evergreen line gets the Evergreen term-count constant, is excluded from Term-Defined fixed-term proration, and (partial periods disabled, no end date) uses full-period count
scenarios.proc_mechanism: Assignment (EvergreenPricingTermCountConstant -> PricingTermCount); ListOperation94 (SellingModelType='TermDefined' OR 'Evergreen'); ListOperation91 (Evergreen AND (AllowPartialProrationPeriods=false OR itemTransientEndDate IsNull))
scenarios.expected_behavior: Evergreen term count applied; full evergreen period billed; no fixed-term/partial proration; Asset continues past initial term unless cancelled
scenarios.test_setup: MSP monthly recurring (e.g. Alert Logic MDR Essentials node tier), Evergreen, AllowPartialProrationPeriods=false, itemTransientEndDate=null, GBP

scenarios.name: Evergreen anytime proration (partial periods + transient end date)
scenarios.what_it_tests: An Evergreen line that allows partial proration periods and has a transient end date enters the anytime (mid-period) proration line filter
scenarios.proc_mechanism: Evergreen anytime proration filter (Line level); ListOperation83 (SellingModelType='Evergreen' AND AllowPartialProrationPeriods=true AND itemTransientEndDate IsNotNull)
scenarios.expected_behavior: Anytime (mid-period) proration computed against the transient end date
scenarios.test_setup: Subscription Evergreen, AllowPartialProrationPeriods=true, itemTransientEndDate mid-period, Qty=2

scenarios.name: Evergreen renewal (auto-continue, no fixed term-end)
scenarios.what_it_tests: An Evergreen line on a renewal/amend (QuoteAction context) keeps its evergreen term-count constant and prior net rather than re-deriving a fixed term; verifies the Evergreen×Renewal cell which is uncovered (catalog has Evergreen-new B-04/B-05 and TermDefined-renewal but no Evergreen-renewal)
scenarios.proc_mechanism: Assignment (EvergreenPricingTermCountConstant -> PricingTermCount) co-resident with Derived/COLA renewal branches; ListOperation94 (SellingModelType='Evergreen') AND QuoteTypeText='Renewal' carry-forward
scenarios.expected_behavior: Evergreen renewal carries prior net (or COLA-uplifted net), keeps evergreen term count, no fixed-term proration, no end-date derivation; asset continues
scenarios.test_setup: Evergreen SaaS line (e.g. Alert Logic MDR node tier), QuoteTypeText='Renewal', QuoteAction.Type='Renew', AllowPartialProrationPeriods=false, GBP

scenarios.name: Usage/tiered model on Quote-to-Order convert + order reprice (tier re-eval on OrderItem context)
scenarios.what_it_tests: A usage/tiered (CalculationMatrix attribute-keyed) line must re-evaluate its tier identically on the OrderItem context after convert; verifies Usage×Convert cell (B-03 covers usage on quote only, F-09 covers convert generically but not the matrix attribute hydration on order side)
scenarios.proc_mechanism: Subscription Pricing + CalculationMatrix tier lookup on OrderItem context; attribute (revenue/nodes/users) must hydrate via OrderEntitiesMapping; whole proc re-run on order
scenarios.expected_behavior: OrderItem tier price identical to quote; matrix attribute hydrated on order context; no $0 no-match from missing order-side attribute mapping
scenarios.test_setup: PhishLabs/Alert Logic tiered line, convert close-won quote to order, Reprice-All, verify tier attribute resolves on OrderItem

scenarios.name: Neither Evergreen nor Term-Defined (one-time) excluded from proration filters
scenarios.what_it_tests: A One-Time/Perpetual line (SellingModelType neither Evergreen nor TermDefined) is excluded from both proration line filters and gets one-time treatment
scenarios.proc_mechanism: ListOperation87 (SellingModelType NotEquals 'Evergreen' AND NotEquals 'TermDefined')
scenarios.expected_behavior: No proration applied; one-time treatment
scenarios.test_setup: Software Perpetual, SellingModelType='OneTime', Qty=3

scenarios.name: Hardware/Power high-quantity line (per-unit decomposition, governor-safe)
scenarios.what_it_tests: A physical Hardware/Power line (GP Item Class OTHER, RC_46000) with large quantity prices each unit and aggregates correctly without CPU/SOQL governor blow-up; can link to a Hardware__c grouping record
scenarios.proc_mechanism: Quantity*Price; Aggregate Price; All Lines Null Safe Filter (LineItemQuantity >= 0); per-unit Power decomposition (1 OrderItem/unit)
scenarios.expected_behavior: Each unit priced; ItemNetTotalPrice correct; no CPU/SOQL governor breach; appliance can link to Hardware record
scenarios.test_setup: Hardware/Power (e.g. Core CTS Gen4 sensor or seat-count Power line), Qty=150 sentinel, New order convert

scenarios.name: Maintenance product type derived pricing (new + renewal, RC_42000/43000/43120)
scenarios.what_it_tests: A maintenance SKU (separate from license) priced as a derived line: new maint as % of list (often 20-24%) via the maintenance derived branch; renewal maint perpetually renewing
scenarios.proc_mechanism: Derived Maintenance Net Filter (ItemIsDerived=true); Derived Pricing Formula (tier% x contributor base); Manual/Partner Discount - Derived Maintenance
scenarios.expected_behavior: Maintenance net = contributor base * tier percent; new maint lines included with license, renewal lines created at asset renewal time
scenarios.test_setup: Derived maintenance (BoKS), ItemIsDerived=true, attached to license, New quote; or Tripwire perpetual + new maint RC_42000

scenarios.name: Software product type aggregation (perpetual, RC_41000)
scenarios.what_it_tests: Software lines (Fortra_Product_Type__c='Software' / GP Item Class SOFTWARE) aggregate into the Software subtotal bucket; license + optional maintenance, no subscription lifecycle
scenarios.proc_mechanism: Total Software (Fortra_Product_Type__c Equals 'Software'); Software Aggregate Price
scenarios.expected_behavior: Software lines summed into Total Software / Software subtotal
scenarios.test_setup: Perpetual software (e.g. Tripwire FIM console), Qty=1-2, mixed-type quote, 10k USD list

scenarios.name: Services product type aggregation
scenarios.what_it_tests: Services lines (Fortra_Product_Type__c='Services' / GP Item Class SERVICES) aggregate into the Services subtotal bucket; priced per hour/day/block, regional multiplier applied if enabled
scenarios.proc_mechanism: Total Services (Fortra_Product_Type__c Equals 'Services'); Services Aggregate Price; regional multiplier if Allow_Regional_Pricing__c=true
scenarios.expected_behavior: Services lines summed into Total Services bucket; no bundle/subscription splitting
scenarios.test_setup: Services (e.g. Digital Guardian setup, SERV SUP), hours 40, rate 250 USD, Qty=1

scenarios.name: Subscription product type / subscription-split aggregation (RC_41202)
scenarios.what_it_tests: Subscription lines aggregate into the Subscription subtotal bucket; subscription-split bundle SKUs (Is Workday Bundle=TRUE) create LIC + MAINT child SKUs for Workday rev-rec while the quote shows one line
scenarios.proc_mechanism: Total Subscription (Fortra_Product_Type__c Equals 'Subscription'); Subscription Aggregate Price; order-time _LIC/_MAINT split for RC_41202 bundles
scenarios.expected_behavior: Subscription lines summed into bucket; quote shows single bundle price; order creates two Workday lines (license/maintenance deferred separately)
scenarios.test_setup: Subscription (e.g. Clearswift Essentials), 12-month term, list 50k, Qty=4

scenarios.name: Add-on / modular feature priced separately but grouped
scenarios.what_it_tests: Add-on SKUs (e.g. GoAnywhere Advanced Workflows, PhishLabs Dark Web add-on) are priced separately and additively but grouped with the primary product line; no special override unless parent bundle pricing gates it
scenarios.proc_mechanism: Product2.Bundle='Add-On'/'Bundle Component'; parent SKU link; additive line pricing
scenarios.expected_behavior: Add-on line included in same group as primary product; no override unless bundle gate
scenarios.test_setup: GoAnywhere Essentials (base 25k) + Advanced Workflows add-on (12.65k) as two lines in same group, subscription

scenarios.name: Mixed-type quote category-bucket isolation (Software+Services+Subscription+Hardware on one quote)
scenarios.what_it_tests: A single quote with all four Fortra_Product_Type buckets must route each line to its own subtotal (Total Software / Total Services / Total Subscription / Hardware) with no cross-contamination, and the four buckets sum to the header; isolated single-type tests (C-01..C-05) exist but not the combined routing/rollup
scenarios.proc_mechanism: Total Software / Total Services / Total Subscription filters on Fortra_Product_Type__c + respective Aggregate Price steps run on the same quote; header rollup sums all buckets
scenarios.expected_behavior: Each line lands in exactly one bucket; buckets sum to Subtotal/TotalPrice; no line counted twice; empty-bucket reset (K-05) honored if a type absent
scenarios.test_setup: One quote: Software perpetual + Services regional + Subscription term-defined + Hardware Power, verify four subtotals and header sum

scenarios.name: Attribute Value Pricing - Calculated Mode
scenarios.what_it_tests: A line with an attribute adjustment in Calculated mode multiplies the base price by the attribute multiplier percent and bridges base/net via IF guards; must price correctly on first reprice
scenarios.proc_mechanism: Attribute Value Pricing - Calculated Mode (Has_Attribute_Adjustment__c=true AND Attribute_Price_Mode__c='Calculated'); Base_Price__c * Attribute_Multiplier_Pct__c; Calculated Mode Base/Net Bridge
scenarios.expected_behavior: InputUnitPrice = Base_Price__c * multiplier; base and net bridged via IF(>0) guards
scenarios.test_setup: Product Has_Attribute_Adjustment__c=true, Attribute_Price_Mode__c='Calculated', multiplier set

scenarios.name: Attribute Value Pricing - Total Price Mode (fixed-price tier lookup)
scenarios.what_it_tests: A line with attribute adjustment in Total Price mode takes Base_Price__c directly as the input unit price (exact per-tier price, no base+multiplier), bridging net/base with IF(>0)
scenarios.proc_mechanism: Attribute Value Pricing - Total Price Mode (Has_Attribute_Adjustment__c=true AND Attribute_Price_Mode__c='Total Price'); Base_Price__c -> InputUnitPrice; Total Price Base/Net Bridge; CalculationMatrix PriceModelType='Total Price'
scenarios.expected_behavior: InputUnitPrice = Base_Price__c (matrix tier price); net/base bridged with IF(>0) guards
scenarios.test_setup: Has_Attribute_Adjustment__c=true, Attribute_Price_Mode__c='Total Price' (e.g. Alert Logic MDR 100-node tier exact MRF)

scenarios.name: Attribute server-type discount config completeness (3-attribute key)
scenarios.what_it_tests: Attribute-based adjustment keyed on Feature x Deployment x ServerType; a missing combination (e.g. {SFTP, OnPrem, NonProd}) yields no match so AttributeDiscount makes no change and net stays at list (also covers GoAnywhere Non-Production 50% rule)
scenarios.proc_mechanism: AttributeBasedPrice step queries Attribute_Based_Adjustment_Decision_Table with 3-attribute key; no match -> no adjustment -> NetUnitPrice stays list
scenarios.expected_behavior: All valid attribute combinations have config rows; {SFTP,OnPrem,NonProd} -> Net != list; Non-Production deployment -> Net = List x 0.5
scenarios.test_setup: GS-GSE-NRPS-AAMP (Advanced Authentication), select {SFTP, OnPrem, NonProd} -> expect Net != 3150 list; GoAnywhere Dev instance -> 50%

scenarios.name: GSA pricing (GSW__c=true) at 50% of list
scenarios.what_it_tests: A GSA/GSW federal-contract line prices at ListPrice * 0.5 (or GSA pricebook variant, e.g. TeamQuest TQG); a standard GSW__c=false/null line is excluded from GSA halving
scenarios.proc_mechanism: GSA Pricing (GSW__c Equals true) formula ListPrice * 0.5 -> InputUnitPrice; negative branch leaves catalog/attribute price
scenarios.expected_behavior: GSW=true: InputUnitPrice = ListPrice * 0.5, no partner stacking; GSW=false: catalog/attribute price retained
scenarios.test_setup: GSW__c=true GSA/federal line, Qty=2; plus a GSW__c=false standard direct line

scenarios.name: Attribute Value Pricing - Unit Price Mode (base + multiplier)
scenarios.what_it_tests: A line with attribute adjustment in Unit Price mode uses Base_Price__c as the unit-price input (Base + Attr*Multiplier per tier), preserving net if >0
scenarios.proc_mechanism: Attribute Value Pricing - Unit Price Mode (Has_Attribute_Adjustment__c=true AND Attribute_Price_Mode__c='Unit Price'); Unit Price Base/Net Bridge; CalculationMatrix PriceModelType='Calculated'
scenarios.expected_behavior: InputUnitPrice = Base + (attribute x multiplier) per tier with bridges; net preserved if >0
scenarios.test_setup: Has_Attribute_Adjustment__c=true, Attribute_Price_Mode__c='Unit Price' (e.g. PhishLabs rev 15B, tier 10-50B, Base 33050, mult 5.5)

scenarios.name: Attribute-Based Price decision-table adjustment (contracted vs catalog)
scenarios.what_it_tests: An attribute-based adjustment decision table applies for lines with ItemContractAttributePasId, gated to non-LastTransaction, non-derived, non-renewal
scenarios.proc_mechanism: Attribute-Based Price + Attribute Discount Entries; Attribute Pricing Filter (ItemContractAttributePasId IsNotNull AND ItemPricingSource NotEquals 'LastTransaction' AND DerivedPricingAttribute IsNotNull AND =false)
scenarios.expected_behavior: Attribute_Based_Adjustment_Decision_Table applies adjustment to NetUnitPrice
scenarios.test_setup: Line with ItemContractAttributePasId set, DerivedPricingAttribute=false, non-renewal

scenarios.name: Volume / quantity-tiered discount (PriceAdjustmentTier step-down)
scenarios.what_it_tests: A qualifying-quantity non-contracted line receives a per-unit price that steps down by quantity band (1-100, 101-250, 251+) via PriceAdjustmentSchedule/Tier
scenarios.proc_mechanism: Volume Discount Entries; Volume Discounts ((IsContracted IsNull OR =false) AND ItemPricingSource NotEquals 'LastTransaction'); PriceAdjustmentSchedule/PriceAdjustmentTier keyed on Qty band
scenarios.expected_behavior: Tier matching ordered qty applies (e.g. Qty=300 uses 251+ band, lower per-unit than 1-100 band)
scenarios.test_setup: Tripwire nodes perpetual, Qty=300, tiers 1-100=220k/node, 101-250 lower; IsContracted=false, New quote

scenarios.name: Bundle-based adjustment / inclusive-price bundle
scenarios.what_it_tests: A bundle child/inclusive-price line receives bundle-based adjustment from the bundle decision table and its inclusive price flows to TotalLineAmount (bundle priced at discount to a-la-carte sum)
scenarios.proc_mechanism: Bundle Based Adjustment Entries (MainItemProduct/RootItemProduct + InclusivePrice); Assignment (InclusivePriceConstant -> TotalLineAmount); ListOperation97 (InclusivePrice Equals true)
scenarios.expected_behavior: Bundle_Based_Adjustment_Decision_Table applies; inclusive bundle price set into TotalLineAmount
scenarios.test_setup: GoAnywhere Starter Bundle (15% off a-la-carte=17.064k) parent + inclusive-price children, InclusivePrice=true

scenarios.name: Attribute mode crossed with currency — Total-Price tier matrix in non-USD
scenarios.what_it_tests: A Total-Price-mode attribute line (Base_Price__c = exact matrix tier price) in a non-USD quote must read a currency-matched tier value, not a USD tier value then FX-multiply (which would double-apply or mismatch); ties D-02/D-05 attribute modes to G-03 currency-blind ABA/ATPS gap at the mode level
scenarios.proc_mechanism: Attribute Value Pricing - Total Price Mode (Base_Price__c -> InputUnitPrice) + CalculationMatrix PriceModelType='Total Price' keyed WITH CurrencyIsoCode; must not FX-convert an already-currency-native tier nor read USD tier
scenarios.expected_behavior: Tier price read from the EUR/GBP matrix row directly (no FX double-apply); if only USD tier exists, surfaced as no-match/error not silent USD value
scenarios.test_setup: Alert Logic MDR 100-node Total-Price tier, EUR quote, verify net = EUR tier (not USD tier × 0.9346 and not raw USD)

scenarios.name: Formula-Based pricing
scenarios.what_it_tests: A formula-priced product computes its unit price via the Formula Based Pricing step from a configured formula
scenarios.proc_mechanism: Formula Based Pricing; Formula Based Pricing 3
scenarios.expected_behavior: Unit price computed from the configured formula
scenarios.test_setup: Product configured with a formula-based pricing rule

scenarios.name: Direct sale - no partner discount (Fortra Originated)
scenarios.what_it_tests: A Fortra-Originated direct deal (Quote.AccountId=end customer, Bill_To=AccountId) is excluded from partner discount steps; list/attribute price flows, subject only to discount-approval thresholds
scenarios.proc_mechanism: Partner Discount (Deal_Type__c NotEquals 'Fortra Originated' gate fails -> skip); Partner Percent Resolved Filter excludes
scenarios.expected_behavior: No partner discount applied; net stays at list/attribute price; AE approval matrix applies
scenarios.test_setup: Deal_Type__c='Fortra Originated'/'Direct', enterprise end customer, Cyber software perpetual, Qty=5

scenarios.name: Channel/Reseller/Distributor partner discount on standard line
scenarios.what_it_tests: A non-Fortra-Originated (partner) non-derived line receives the resolved partner discount percent from Partner_Pricing_Model__c, selected by product type and hierarchy (Solution Category->Group->Unit); discount-model uses billing partner only, guaranteed-margin stacks all partners
scenarios.proc_mechanism: Partner Discount (Deal_Type__c NotEquals 'Fortra Originated' AND (ItemIsDerived IsNull OR =false)); Resolve Partner Discount Percent; Partner Percent Resolved Filter (PartnerDiscountPercent IsNotNull AND >0)
scenarios.expected_behavior: Discount model: Net = List x (1-BillingPartner%); Guaranteed Margin: Net = List x (1-A%) x (1-B%); net != list
scenarios.test_setup: Deal_Type__c='Channel Originated', reseller (Optiv Diamond 20% SW) or 2-tier distributor (M.Tech 40% SW), ItemIsDerived=false, Qty=3

scenarios.name: Partner discount calculated but not applied on One-Time/Perpetual (SubscriptionPricing overwrite)
scenarios.what_it_tests: Partner discount % correctly written to NetUnitPrice by the Partner Discount step but the One-Time/Perpetual SubscriptionPricing branch re-reads un-discounted InputUnitPrice and overwrites net, losing the discount
scenarios.proc_mechanism: V9 SubscriptionPricing74 (One-Time branch, seq24) outputs InputUnitPrice->NetUnitPrice instead of preserving discounted net like TermDefined branch SubscriptionPricing80; PartnerDiscount22 (seq10) net writes overwritten
scenarios.expected_behavior: One-Time line applies partner discount to final net: NetUnitPrice = InputUnitPrice x (1-PartnerDiscountPercent), persisted through subscription pricing
scenarios.test_setup: One-Time perpetual product, partner deal, 20% discount, list 2008, expect net 1706.8

scenarios.name: Fortra-Originated partner discount band (Non_Orig_* percents)
scenarios.what_it_tests: A Deal_Type__c='Fortra Originated' partner deal pulls its discount from the Non_Orig_* columns (typically lower tier than channel-originated)
scenarios.proc_mechanism: Partner_Pricing_Model__c Non_Orig_Software_Pct__c / Non_Orig_Subscription_Pct__c etc.; Deal Origin picklist drives column set
scenarios.expected_behavior: Net = List x (1 - Non_Orig_Discount%); lower discount than channel-originated (e.g. 12% vs 20%)
scenarios.test_setup: Partner A (20% channel orig / 12% fortra orig), Deal_Type='Fortra Originated' -> 12%

scenarios.name: MSP sale - single invoice, lines grouped per end customer
scenarios.what_it_tests: A Channel MSP deal where the MSP is Bill-To and Customer of Record produces a single order/invoice but lines internally grouped per end customer (via Quote Line Group + Hardware record); renewals propagate the grouping
scenarios.proc_mechanism: Quote.AccountId=MSP; Quote Line Group + Hardware record grouping; single Workday invoice; partner pricing per MSP account
scenarios.expected_behavior: Single order/invoice to MSP; lines grouped per end customer; co-termed renewals keep grouping
scenarios.test_setup: Meridian IT (MSP), billing GBP, lines grouped per end-customer, Powertech renewals co-termed

scenarios.name: GSA (GSW=true) crossed with partner deal — no discount stacking
scenarios.what_it_tests: A line that is both GSW__c=true and on a partner Deal_Type must apply GSA 50% ONLY and must NOT also stack the partner discount (D-04 notes 'no partner stacking' but no scenario crosses GSW×partner explicitly)
scenarios.proc_mechanism: GSA Pricing (GSW=true) ListPrice*0.5 -> InputUnitPrice; Partner Discount must be gated off or its net write must not compound the GSA-halved price
scenarios.expected_behavior: Net = ListPrice*0.5 (GSA); partner percent NOT additionally applied; net != 0.5*list*(1-partner%)

scenarios.name: Order line-type FIXED AMOUNT vs BILLING ONLY on splits
